title: RDF vocabulary conformance configuration
description: Data-only configuration for rdf-vocabulary-conformance-service. A Science repository holds one of these (conventionally ontology/conformance.json) next to its vocabulary and records. Every path is relative to the repository root, uses forward slashes, and contains no '..' segment. Every IRI is absolute. A section that is absent switches off the checks that need it.

rdf.description: RDF files (.ttl, .nt, .n3, .rdf, .xml, .owl) matching the glob must each parse to a non-empty graph.

minimum.description: At least this many files must match.

json.description: JSON or JSON-LD files matching the glob must each be a JSON object.

exactly.description: The matched set must equal exactly these paths.

files.description: RDF files merged into the vocabulary graph.

namespace.description: The namespace the vocabulary owns. Classes and properties declared in it must be documented; record top types must live in it.

declaredTermsAtLeast.description: At least this many owl:Class, owl:ObjectProperty and owl:DatatypeProperty terms are declared in the namespace.

versionIri.description: Expected owl:versionIRI. '{iri}' stands for ontology.iri and '{version}' for the value read by versionInfoFrom.

versionInfoFrom.description: owl:versionInfo must equal the first capture group of this regular expression (multiline) over the named file.

root.description: The vendored root ontology the vocabulary is rooted in, and the shapes that judge ontology metadata.

shapes.description: Root-owned SHACL shapes for ontology metadata.

iri.description: The root must declare itself an owl:Ontology at this IRI.

recordClass.description: The root must declare this owl:Class; every record kind must be a subclass of it.

validate.description: RDF files that, each merged with the root ontology, must conform to the root shapes.

skos.description: SKOS discipline for the vocabulary graph.

glossary.description: Concepts that keep house IRIs and trace to a pinned source.

source.description: Each glossary concept has exactly one dcterms:source matching pattern. commitPattern's first capture group extracts the pinned commit; singleCommit requires all sources to carry the same one.

derivedFrom.description: Each glossary concept has exactly one prov:wasDerivedFrom matching pattern.

projection.description: A generated SKOS JSON-LD projection (an @graph of nodes with compact skos:prefLabel, skos:notation, skos:definition and skos:related keys) that must agree with the vocabulary for every glossary concept.

definitionPrefixLength.description: The vocabulary definition's first N characters must open the projection's definition. Default 80.

countPointer.description: JSON Pointer to the projection's own concept count, which must equal the number of glossary concepts.

closedSets.description: Each class is exactly the owl:oneOf list of one of its owl:equivalentClass expressions, and no other individual claims membership.

labelSets.description: The skos:prefLabel strings of the instances of a class equal exactly this set.

records.description: JSON data records: each is converted to RDF through a JSON-LD 1.1 context and judged by SHACL shapes.

context.description: A JSON-LD file whose top-level @context is applied to every record.

baseIri.description: Must end in '/'. A record at <dir>/<stem>.json becomes the node <baseIri><stem>, with @base <baseIri><stem>/.

unmappedPrefix.description: Predicates and types under this IRI prefix are the context's @vocab fallback: a record key the context does not map.

topTypeNamespace.description: Every rdf:type of a record's top node must start with this IRI. Defaults to vocabulary.namespace when that is set.

kinds.description: Record path to the class its top node must have. The matched record set must equal these keys, and each class must be a subclass of root.recordClass.

graphExpectations.description: Structural expectations over a converted record graph.

count.description: Exactly this many distinct objects of the predicate.

objectTypes.description: The union of rdf:types of those objects equals exactly this set.

shapeTests.description: Negative (and baseline) tests: an RFC 6902 JSON Patch is applied to a copy of a record, and the result must violate or conform. They prove the shapes bite.

mutation.description: RFC 6902 operations; an empty list leaves the record unchanged.

via.description: How a violation must be detected. 'shacl' (default): the SHACL report does not conform. 'context': the conversion leaves a key or type unmapped. Ignored for 'conforms', which requires both to be clean.

path.description: A relative, forward-slash repository path with no '..' segment.

glob.description: A path pattern: '*' and '?' stay inside one path segment, '**' crosses segments.

regex.description: A Python regular expression, matched with re.search.

slug.description: A stable identifier unique within its array.
